risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantified, but highlights material exposure to declining and volatile oil and gas production, commodity prices, timber markets, and resource depletion. Revenue declined substantially and general and administrative expense increased, although management presents liquidity as adequate and expects broadly flat oil and gas revenue. Several outlook statements rely on expectations and standard forward-looking disclaimers, with referenced tables absent from the excerpt.
